run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend-proxy since 2026-11-16T16:36:01Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: frontend-proxy's elevated request error rate is not an internal frontend-proxy fault: Envoy keeps serving, but the upstream frontend returns HTTP 500 for product and checkout routes, starting ~16:36-16:38, because the product-catalog dependency stopped serving. The product-catalog Deployment was rolled to a new ReplicaSet (product-catalog-56fbb5f966, created 2026-11-16T16:36:13Z) whose only container image is quay.io/it-bench/hello-bench-invalid:1.0.0; that image cannot be pulled (ErrImagePull / Back-off pulling image, 401 UNAUTHORIZED), so the pod product-catalog-56fbb5f966-h9xjk is Pending with the container in ImagePullBackOff and the Deployment has 0 ready / 1 unavailable replica. The previously serving ReplicaSet product-catalog-7c7f8b68dc (ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-product-catalog) was scaled 1→0 at 16:36:21Z, so nothing serves the Service: its Endpoints object holds only notReadyAddresses for 100.96.4.116 while the Service clusterIP is 100.69.9.250:8080, exactly the address in the observed gRPC failure '14 UNAVAILABLE: No connection established. Last error: connect EPERM 100.69.9.250:8080'. frontend, checkout and recommendation all record errors on their ProductCatalogService calls, product-catalog's own spans drop to zero, and frontend-proxy logs the resulting 500s (via_upstream) on GET /api/products/* and POST /api/checkout while other routes keep returning 200. Evidence: 2e92439f-39c9-47d1-83d6-16e36abc6673-t0:27e2f893-e25c-4875-8bf9-13b38e76a380, 2e92439f-39c9-47d1-83d6-16e36abc6673-t1:6c131dc4-0c97-4550-9f7e-bd7305290636, d37af806-ff0e-4282-8953-a78696a89ad9-t0:1b0b77ae-2049-4760-aec9-106de76ba0a7, d37af806-ff0e-4282-8953-a78696a89ad9-t1:bf94f8fa-7cd7-48fa-beb8-984c388ab575, 21df7c23-1c68-4d37-bf6c-3fcbc93a1997-t1:2348ae69-8a42-4314-8c7e-cb12409bc8b4, 21df7c23-1c68-4d37-bf6c-3fcbc93a1997-t0:7fb02b47-8377-44c3-8615-97e5cbfc8260, 7808dcd9-9c2a-45fd-a73e-6e26c292ea05-t0:eae435ba-a217-4833-a0ef-80d8ca479b30, cedb64c1-77ee-4f99-ae47-45292d240c30-t1:e151f292-1a3e-4809-a4a6-adb5c12e702d, 2b1eb9fd-66eb-4833-8a87-4821f0cb1e92-t1:7626ed2f-f7de-49bf-9090-869d90f29997.

claims.text: frontend-proxy span metrics show STATUS_CODE_ERROR spans on both operations 'ingress' (server) and 'router frontend egress' (client); the 15m increase of error spans rose from ~1.25/5m baseline before 16:37 to 4390 spans in the window ending 16:44:01, while STATUS_CODE_UNSET ingress spans declined from ~10.6k to ~4.1k, i.e. errors appeared inside otherwise continuing traffic.

frontend-proxy container logs during 16:45:41-16:45:42Z show 'GET /api/products/<id> HTTP/1.1" 500 - via_upstream' and 'POST /api/checkout HTTP/1.1" 500 - via_upstream' while 'GET /api/data HTTP/1.1" 200' and 'POST /api/cart HTTP/1.1" 200' were served normally, so the proxy itself answers but its upstream returns 500 for product/checkout routes.

frontend spans carry the failing HTTP 500s: operations 'GET', 'GET /api/products/{productId}' (http.status_code 500), 'POST /api/checkout' and internal 'executing api route (pages) /api/checkout' with exception '13 INTERNAL: failed to prepare order: failed to get product #"6E92ZMYYFZ"', and the client span 'grpc.oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct' with otel.status_code ERROR and rpc.grpc.status_code 14.

The exact gRPC failure on frontend's span 'grpc.oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct' is '14 UNAVAILABLE: No connection established. Last error: connect EPERM 100.69.9.250:8080 - Local (0.0.0.0:0)', i.e. a connection failure to the product-catalog address, not a slow response.

product-catalog's own server spans stopped: the 5m increase for span 'oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct' fell from 3111 at the window ending 16:38:01 to 487 at 16:41:01 and 0 from the window ending 16:42:01 onward; 'oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/ListProducts' behaved the same. No STATUS_CODE_ERROR series exists for product-catalog, so the dependency stopped emitting spans rather than reporting errors.

Pod product-catalog-56fbb5f966-h9xjk (owner ReplicaSet product-catalog-56fbb5f966, started 2026-11-16T16:36:29Z) is phase Pending, Ready=False (ContainersNotReady), restartCount 0, and its container product-catalog is waiting with reason ImagePullBackOff: 'Back-off pulling image "quay.io/it-bench/hello-bench-invalid:1.0.0": ErrImagePull ... unexpected status from HEAD request to https://quay.io/v2/it-bench/hello-bench-invalid/manifests/1.0.0: 401 UNAUTHORIZED'.

Deployment product-catalog now specifies image quay.io/it-bench/hello-bench-invalid:1.0.0 (deployment revision 2, generation 4) with status replicas 1 / unavailableReplicas 1 and condition Available=False reason MinimumReplicasUnavailable; the older ReplicaSet product-catalog-7c7f8b68dc (created 16:02:40Z) used ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-product-catalog and is scaled to 0 replicas.

Kubernetes events in otel-demo show the rollout and its failure: ReplicaSet product-catalog-56fbb5f966 SuccessfulCreate at 16:36:14Z and 16:36:29Z, repeated Failed 'Failed to pull image ... 401 UNAUTHORIZED' and 'Error: ImagePullBackOff' events on those pods, Deployment 'Scaled down replica set product-catalog-7c7f8b68dc from 1 to 0' at 16:36:21Z with Pod 'Stopping container product-catalog' / SuccessfulDelete for pod product-catalog-7c7f8b68dc-qz548. No Evicted or OOMKilling event appears for product-catalog.

Service product-catalog has clusterIP 100.69.9.250, port 8080/tcp-service, and its Endpoints object contains only notReadyAddresses (pod product-catalog-56fbb5f966-h9xjk, ip 100.96.4.116) - there is no ready endpoint behind the address that clients fail to connect to.

The same dependency failure is visible in other callers' own spans: checkout error spans on 'oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct' and 'oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder' (5m increase 91.6 at 16:35:01 rising to ~201 at 16:39:01) and recommendation error spans on '/oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/ListProducts' and 'get_product_list' (117.8 at 16:35:01 to ~327 at 16:43:01); frontend error spans by operation are 'GET', 'GET /api/products/{productId}', 'POST /api/checkout', 'grpc.oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct' and 'grpc.oteldemo.RecommendationService/ListRecommendations'.

frontend-proxy and frontend are not crashed: pod frontend-proxy-6b4d584985-zj87n and pod frontend-675fd7b5c5-gx54w are Running, ready=true, restartCount 0, started 16:02:39Z; across the namespace only product-catalog has 0 ready replicas while the other 20 deployments report 1 ready/1 available. frontend-proxy logs also show successful 200 responses on other routes in the same seconds as the 500s.

Rejected: that the frontend-proxy errors were caused by latency/saturation at frontend-proxy or frontend. The failing product-catalog calls returned immediately with gRPC status 14 'No connection established ... connect EPERM 100.69.9.250:8080' (span durations 436us and 35.7ms) - connection refusal, not deadline exceeded - and frontend/frontend-proxy pods were ready with 0 restarts.

Other services do not show a comparable error surge: accounting and payment error series returned 0 across the 10m windows, and ad / fraud-detection show only a steady ~1.05 per 10m on 'flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/EventStream' (a long-lived flag stream present before and during the incident, not a product-catalog call). No error series were returned for cart, shipping, currency, email, image-provider or quote, so their error state is unknown rather than proven zero.

Roll the product-catalog Deployment back to a pullable image (the previous ReplicaSet used ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-product-catalog) or fix/re-authenticate quay.io/it-bench/hello-bench-invalid:1.0.0, then confirm pod product-catalog-56fbb5f966-h9xjk's replacement is Running and Ready and that the product-catalog Endpoints object gains ready addresses before treating the frontend-proxy RequestErrorRate alert as resolved.

gaps: The alerting rule named RequestErrorRate was not returned by list_prometheus_rules (rule_name filter returned status no_data), so the alert's exact expression, threshold and lookback could not be verified.

Metrics listed as available for this target such as rpc_client_duration_milliseconds_count, rpc_server_duration_milliseconds_bucket, http_server_request_duration_seconds_count and app_payment_transactions_total returned no series (get_metric_names for {__name__=~"rpc_.*|http_.*|app_.*"} was no_data), so the alert's reported value 18.1888 could not be reproduced from its own metric; only traces_span_metrics_* plus container/process metrics exist.
The change_history integration is not available in this Run, so who changed the product-catalog Deployment image, when the change was applied, and whether it was intended cannot be confirmed.

frontend pod logs returned no lines at all for 16:30-16:51Z (status no_data for the current container), so frontend application log text could not be read; the frontend 500s were confirmed only through spans and frontend-proxy access logs.

The previously serving pod product-catalog-7c7f8b68dc-qz548 was deleted by the rollout, so its logs and last termination state are unavailable; its removal is evidenced only by ReplicaSet/Deployment events.
The replacement container product-catalog-56fbb5f966-h9xjk never started (waiting ImagePullBackOff), so it produced no container logs.
Prometheus sample series in this window begin around 16:14:01Z, so behaviour earlier in the authorized window is not covered by these metric views.
Trace and span-metric views are biased samples and span counts, not unique request counts; the fraction of user requests failing is not established by them.
next_steps: Inspect the product-catalog Deployment rollout history and Helm release values to see why template image became quay.io/it-bench/hello-bench-invalid:1.0.0, then roll back to ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-product-catalog.
If the new image is intended, verify registry credentials/repository access for quay.io/it-bench/hello-bench-invalid:1.0.0 (the pull failed with 401 UNAUTHORIZED).
After the rollout is corrected, confirm product-catalog has 1 ready replica and ready Endpoints entries, and watch frontend-proxy 5xx on /api/products/* and /api/checkout clear.
